claims.claim: Morning's documented token endpoint is POST https://api.morning.co/idp/v1/oauth/token. In the bundled OpenAPI spec the path item /idp/v1/oauth/token carries its own servers override to https://api.morning.co (Production) and https://api.sandbox.morning.dev (Sandbox), while the spec's global servers are https://api.greeninvoice.co.il/api/v1 (Production) and https://sandbox.d.greeninvoice.co.il/api/v1 (Sandbox). The access token is a signed JWT valid for 1 hour.
claims.raw_snippet: This endpoint returns an access token (issued as a signed JWT) in the response body as `accessToken`. Please be advised that the `accessToken` is valid for 1 hour.
claims.secondary_raw_snippet: All error responses follow the OAuth 2.0 error format (RFC 6749)

claims.claim: Morning's POST /documents takes CreateDocumentRequest, whose required fields are ["type", "lang", "currency", "vatType", "income"]. The line array is `income[]` (IncomeRowRequest); there is no `items` property. Each income row requires ["description", "quantity", "price", "currency", "vatType"], so the price field is `price`, not `unitPrice`.
claims.raw_snippet: "CreateDocumentRequest" required: ["type", "lang", "currency", "vatType", "income"]; properties include "income" and not "items"
claims.verified_via: curl of the bundled spec 2026-09-02, schema properties read directly

claims.claim: The Morning create-document response does not carry the allocation number. CreateDocumentResponse properties are ["id", "number", "dueDate", "type", "signed", "lang", "client", "taxAuthorityConfirmationInitiated", "url", "taxAuthorityConfirmationLastError", "vatRate"], which includes taxAuthorityConfirmationInitiated and taxAuthorityConfirmationLastError but not allocationNumber. `allocationNumber` is a property of the Document schema, so it must be read from GET /documents/{id} or the document/created webhook.
claims.raw_snippet: "CreateDocumentResponse" properties: ["id", "number", "dueDate", "type", "signed", "lang", "client", "taxAuthorityConfirmationInitiated", "url", "taxAuthorityConfirmationLastError", "vatRate"]
claims.secondary_raw_snippet: "allocationNumber" is defined on the Document schema, described as "Allocation Number issued by the Israeli Tax Authority"
claims.verified_via: curl of the bundled spec 2026-09-02, schema properties read directly

claims.claim: The Cardcom v11 webhook body (LowProfileResult) has NO top-level `Amount` property. Its properties are ResponseCode, Description, TerminalNumber, LowProfileId, TranzactionId, ReturnValue, Operation, UIValues, DocumentInfo, TokenInfo, SuspendedInfo, TranzactionInfo, ExternalPaymentVector, Country, UTM, IssuerAuthCodeDescription, AccountId. The paid amount is at TranzactionInfo.Amount (TransactionInfo schema, type number, format decimal). TranzactionInfo is nullable outside the ChargeOnly and ChargeAndCreateToken operations. The `Amount` field people copy is on the CreateLowProfile REQUEST schema, not the callback.
claims.raw_snippet: Transaction information, Will no be null at operations: ChargeOnly, ChargeAndCreateToken
claims.verified_via: curl of the live v11 OpenAPI spec 2026-09-02, LowProfileResult properties enumerated directly
